description.value: A free backcountry campsite accessible only on foot in or near Mount Assiniboine Provincial Park, a UNESCO World Heritage area of glaciers and alpine meadows; no road access of any kind, no services, and rapidly changing mountain weather.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a backcountry camp_site within Mount Assiniboine Provincial Park; the BC Parks website confirms the park has no road access ('No roads pass through the park, with trails providing the only land access') and is 'a remote backcountry area, with no services or facilities in most areas.' The website explicitly references backcountry camping reservations for the park. No campground-specific detail for Surprise Creek Campground appears in the fetched content — the page covers the entire park and directs visitors to a separate PDF for individual campground information, so most amenity fields cannot be confirmed.
concerns: Trail-only access: BC Parks website explicitly states 'No roads pass through the park, with trails providing the only land access' — unsuitable for road-touring cyclists.
OSM fee=no tag is likely outdated or incorrect; BC Parks backcountry camping generally requires reservation fees and the website references '2026 fee changes.'
